verdicts.title: Computing the unit group of a commutative finite $\mathbb{Z}$-algebra
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: For a commutative finite $\mathbb{Z}$-algebra, i.e., for a commutative ring $R$ whose additive group is finitely generated, it is known that the group of units of $R$ is finitely generated, as well. Our main results are algorithms to compute generators and the structure of this group.
